[[File:Sevii tags-0.png|thumb]] The Sevii Islands is one of the two post-game regions in the game, along with [[Johto]]. It is an archipelago composed of Islands 1, 2, 3 and 5 from [[bulbapedia:Pok%C3%A9mon_FireRed_and_LeafGreen_Versions|Pokémon Fire Red and Leaf Green]] in which the Sevii Islands first appeared. Unlike in the original games however, the islands are all directly connected with each other by routes. A new route, '''Brine Road''' was added to bridge the gap between the islands. The first Island, [[Knot Island]], is accessible by taking the ferry from [[Cinnabar Island]] after obtaining the Seagallop Pass from the rival after defeating Team Rocket in [[Mt. Ember]]. The rest of the islands are locked until the player obtains '''Dive''' and the '''Golbat Boots''' during the post-game. There are 2 badges to collect in the region in addition to the 8 badges from the main story. ==Cities== ===Knot Island=== [[Knot Island]] is the first island that the player visits upon arriving in the Sevii Islands. ====Landmarks==== *Pokémon Market *Move Export House *[[Treasure Beach]] *Knot Island Harbour *[[Triple Battle Lounge]] ===Boon Island=== [[Boon Island]] is a small island that is accessible from [[Brine Road (West of the Old Shipwreck)]]. It is the location of [[Gym_Leaders#Chuck_(Boon_Island)|Chuck]], one of the post-game Gym Leaders. ====Landmarks==== *Boon Island Market *Joyful Game Corner *Legendary Move Expert House *Hidden Abilities House *Boon Island Harbour *[[Navel Rock]] ===Kin Island=== [[Kin Island]] is an island in the North-Eastern part of [[Brine Road (East of the Old Shipwreck)]]. It is the most populous of the Sevii Islands and the only island to feature a hotel. It is the location of [[Gym_Leaders#Jasmine_(Kin_Island)|Jasmine]], one of the post-game Gym Leaders. ====Landmarks==== *Kin Island Hotel *EV berries seller *[[Bond Bridge]] *[[Berry Forest]] *Kin Island Harbour *[[Sky Pillar]] *[[Birth Island]] ===Chrono Island=== [[Chrono Island]] is the last Sevii Island that players will typically visit. It is located South-East of the [[Water Labyrinth]]. ====Landmarks==== *[[Rocket Warehouse]] *Heart Scales seller *Chrono Island Harbour *[[P2 Laboratory]] ==Routes == ===Kindle Road=== The first time the player arrives in Sevii Islands and come out from [[Offshore Road]], they arrive in Kindle Road. ====Landmarks==== *Ember Spa *[[Offshore Road]] *[[Mt. Ember]] *[[Ruby Chamber]] ===Brine Road === The route is split into: [[Brine Road (West of the Old Shipwreck)]] and [[Brine Road (East of the Old Shipwreck)]]. The former can be accessed as soon as the player acquires Dive, but the latter can only be accessed after the player gets the Golbat Boots. ====Landmarks==== *[[Old Shipwreck]] *[[Deep Sea]] *[[Sapphire Cave]] ===Bond Bridge=== The route connects [[Kin Island]] to the [[Berry Forest]]. ====Landmarks==== *[[Berry Forest]] ===Water Labyrinth=== Strong currents makes this route hard to navigate with Surf. The only way to reach this route is from Brine Road, and is blocked by Corsolas. ====Landmarks==== *[[Resort Gorgeous]] *[[Sealed Chamber]]
